title: Max and the Halloween Parade
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: It is the day of the McKinley Halloween Parade! Max comes to school in a costume.
Max is dressed as an astronaut, with a silver suit and a big round helmet made of paper.
There are rules for costumes. No masks, so everyone can see your face. Nothing scary or gory. And you must wear shoes!
Max's helmet has a big hole in the front, so everyone can see Max's happy face.
Families stand behind the yellow tape on the blacktop. They wave and take pictures.
Max's class walks around the parade track. Max sees a taco, a dinosaur, a rainbow, and three cats.
Max waves to the crowd. "Hello from outer space!"
At the end, the big kids in fourth and fifth grade do the Thriller dance. They move like silly zombies!
Max tries the zombie arms too. The helmet falls off, and everyone giggles. It was the best parade ever.
